claims.name: Collector marking repeatedly scans slots and reachable edges
claims.scope: collect rejects any active guard, initializes marks from roots, repeatedly scans physical slots and marked-object edges/reference slots until stable, then sweeps all slots.
assumptions: S denotes physical slot-vector length, V occupied reachable objects, E reachable edge/reference positions examined. No timing or empirical scaling was measured.
obligations: Count pass-dependent work as O(P*(S+E)+S), with P at most V+1 and unfavorable reverse slot-order chains requiring many passes.
A worklist candidate has O(V+E) marking plus O(S) root initialization/sweep; account for O(V) scratch or intrusive metadata, reservations, failure policy and region/budget effects.
